question: At N=32 and N=100, on the full Hiratani 2×2, do CF and GLUE (Δ log α sign) still organise like the N=300 grid, over 8 inits of one arrangement?
why: S-HH-only n=4 found lazy CF leaving the N≥150 band at N=32 (mean 0.086) while rich S-HH stayed at CF=0. That cannot locate a corner effect versus a lazy-width effect without S-HL/S-LH/S-LL, and n=4 is short of the paper’s unique n=8. GLUE was logged but not scored. This expansion scores both currencies on the full similarity grid. N=32 GLUE is packed (D_eff ~1.3 in the S-HL smoke); signs are the GLUE claim, not channel-share magnitudes.

reference_N300_stream0_unique_n8.source: results/phase1/ a=0, stream_id=0, seeds 0–7 (the grid’s unique n=8)
reference_N300_stream0_unique_n8.note_S-LH_rich_CF_is_small: S-LH at γ=10 has CF 0.013, not 0.4. High readout similarity preserves accuracy. S-HH is the only corner with CF~0 at both γ.

design.imported_not_retrained: 20 arms: results/shh_width/ (S-HH, seeds 0–3, both N and γ) and results/width_smoke/ (S-HL, seed 0, both N and γ). Copied into this directory; specs identical.

sampling_unit: initialisation. Eight seeds are eight inits of stream_rng(0). Not an arrangement-level claim. Not pooled with N=300.

statistics.CF: Per (N, γ, condition): mean, min, max over 8 seeds of forgetting_metrics CF, and of past-task accuracy (last accuracy-matrix row, current task excluded). Unusable arms are kept in the mean and counted.
statistics.GLUE: Per (N, γ, condition): mean over 8 seeds of Δ log α (task 0, lag 15, module A, retained) and of Δρ_c_signed (boundary 15 − 0, task 0, module A). Channel shares and D_eff are logged. At N=32, D_eff is expected packed; magnitudes of Δ log α are not compared to N=300.
statistics.clouds: N=32, seed 0, all four conditions, both γ (8 npz). Not a decision input.

decision_rule.rich_CF_2x2_survives: At a given N, γ=10: mean CF(S-HH) ≤ 0.01 AND mean CF(S-HL) ≥ 0.25 AND the order of the four mean CFs is S-HL > S-LL > S-LH > S-HH. Then the rich behavioural 2×2 is intact at that width, on this arrangement.
decision_rule.rich_CF_2x2_breaks: At that N, γ=10: mean CF(S-HH) ≥ 0.05 OR mean CF(S-HL) < 0.20 OR the CF order among the four corners is not S-HL > S-LL > S-LH > S-HH. Then rich behavioural organisation does not match N=300 at that width.
decision_rule.lazy_S-HH_CF_break_confirmed: At N=32, γ=0.03: mean CF(S-HH) ≥ 0.05 over 8 seeds. Then the n=4 lazy-S-HH break stands at n=8. (Already expected from shh_width.)
decision_rule.glue_signs_match: At a given N, γ=10: mean Δ log α > 0 on S-HH and < 0 on S-HL, S-LH, S-LL. Then GLUE’s gain-vs-loss pattern matches N=300 in sign. Magnitudes at N=32 are not a pass/fail.
decision_rule.glue_signs_break: At that N, γ=10: S-HH mean Δ log α ≤ 0, or any of the three loss corners has mean Δ log α ≥ 0. Then the GLUE 2×2 sign pattern failed.
decision_rule.N32_packing: If mean D_eff (generic, boundary 0, module A) at N=32 is < 2.0, packing is confirmed. GLUE signs may still be scored; channel shares must not be quoted as a test of §5.
decision_rule.intermediate: Any cell that is neither survive nor break on that rule: report means and range, do not rewrite the paper.
will_not_quote: the imported 20 as a fresh sample — they are overlap

can_show: whether, at one arrangement and 8 inits, the 2×2 of CF and the sign pattern of Δ log α at γ=10 still match N=300 at N=32 and N=100, and whether the lazy-S-HH CF break replicates at n=8
reporting: off-design, own directory, never adopted by grid.load(). Score with scripts/analyse_small_n_grid.py. The imported 20 are listed in the score file.
